baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired messenger nouns, confirming participle, announcing participle, coming, and after me form a backward-and-forward sequence inside 61:6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The present messenger is a relay joint: he verifies an already entrusted disclosure while making the next dispatch perceptible before its arrival. Confirmation and announcement are therefore complementary directions of one transmission rather than separate credentials.

activation_trace.role: Succession in batches turns the two messenger occurrences into adjacent links of a relay.
Confirmation as fulfillment makes relation to the Torah an enacted validation, not verbal agreement alone.
A forerunner or first visible sign lets the announcement begin the later messenger's appearance in advance.
Afterness supplies the temporal spacing across which the relay must continue.

changed_reading.before: Jesus states his mission, confirms the Torah, and predicts a later messenger.
changed_reading.after: Jesus occupies a relay joint whose backward fulfillment already makes the next messenger's later arrival partially present.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction between my hands is followed by a messenger who comes after me.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse spatializes time as custody and transfer. What precedes is not merely earlier; it is presently before the messenger's hands, while what follows must cross an interval through a successive dispatch. The messenger stands between inherited trust and onward handoff.

activation_trace.role: The interval between things gives the verse's temporal sequence a traversable middle.
Hand-to-hand transfer makes what is before the hands an entrusted custody capable of onward passage.
Afterness fixes the receiving side of the handoff beyond the present messenger.
Reciprocal sending and matching supplies continuity between the entrusted links.

changed_reading.before: Before me and after me are ordinary temporal locators.
changed_reading.after: Before and after become a spatial handoff: inherited disclosure is held in the present and matched to a future recipient across an interval.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: His name is Ahmad precedes the arrival with clear signs and the answering label this is clear magic.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus ayah stages a contest of designation. A raised name and identifying mark precede arrival; signs then disclose meaning; the respondents use speech to reassign those signs to the category of diversion. The dispute is over how an arrival is to be recognized, not simply whether something happened.

activation_trace.role: A name as raised designation projects an identity ahead of the arrival.
The split-root image of a visible identifying mark makes the announced name a recognition device.
Disclosure by expression or sign gives the arriving proofs their identifying function.
Diversion and deception supplies the respondents' counterclassification of disclosed signs.
False saying or attribution makes the closing utterance an attempted reassignment of what the evidence is.

changed_reading.before: Ahmad is named, then his signs are dismissed as magic.
changed_reading.after: A prospective identifying mark meets a rival spoken label; the scene tests whether disclosed signs will be recognized under the announced designation or diverted into a false category.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: One root spans between, clear signs, and clear in the final accusation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The threefold root carries interval, connection, disclosure, and separation through the verse. The same linguistic field that links Torah to the present and makes signs evident also sharpens the rejecting label. Clarity here can expose a relation and simultaneously become the line along which hearers divide.

activation_trace.role: A tie between parties lets the root connect earlier scripture, present testimony, and arriving signs.
Becoming clear makes disclosure a real event within the scene.
Separation keeps open the paradox that evident material can produce a sharper rupture.
Bringing or presenting something makes the signs a public disclosure rather than private information.

changed_reading.before: The repeated root has unrelated local senses: between, proofs, and evident.
changed_reading.after: Interval becomes connection, connection becomes disclosed evidence, and disclosure becomes the very edge on which the audience separates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening cosmic motion activates a fluid model of the focus sequence. Successive messengers move through a temporal medium, while announcement clears a channel ahead; continuity is dynamic passage rather than a row of static offices.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or running supplies movement through a surrounding medium as the contextual trigger.
Succession in batches anchors the current as repeated dispatch within the focus ayah.
A watercourse with its flow cleared turns coming into movement along an opened channel.
The middle interval gives that flow a span to cross without erasing distinct messengers.

structural_cues: 61:1 places all that is in the heavens and earth in one ongoing act before the focus scene.
61:6 itself sequences confirmation, announcement, coming, and afterness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies swimming, a cleared watercourse, succession, and an interval; I infer one temporal current carrying distinct dispatches. The live alternative is that 61:1 contributes only worshipful orientation and no transport model.

changed_reading.before: Messenger succession is a static chronology of officeholders.
changed_reading.after: Messenger succession can be read as distinct dispatches moving through one current, with announcement opening the channel ahead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The saying-doing indictment turns 61:6 into a test of performative recognition. Jesus speaks, the signs arrive and indicate, and the audience speaks back. Their final label is deficient not because it is speech, but because it substitutes classification for a fitting response to what has become present.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the contextual side of the explicit saying-doing test.
Producing an act supplies the missing realization against which utterance is measured.
A thing's indication as its saying allows the signs themselves to stand between the two human utterances.
Presentation of something gives the announced claim an event-like evidentiary realization.

structural_cues: The saying-doing formula is repeated in 61:2-3.
61:6 is framed by he said and they said, with arrival and signs between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit mismatch between utterance and deed plus a focus sequence of utterance, arrival, signs, and counter-utterance; I infer that recognition is the fitting act withheld. An alternative is that 61:2-3 addresses only believers' conduct and does not govern the later dialogue.

changed_reading.before: The focus records two opposed verbal claims about a messenger.
changed_reading.after: The focus tests whether speech will answer an event truthfully: the signs indicate between two utterances, and the second utterance evades enactment of what the first announced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The compacted building activates the two filial expressions in 61:6 as structural placements. Son of Mary and sons of Israel locate speaker and audience within derived belonging, while the two messenger links behave like joined supports. Genealogy, community, and transmission become one architecture whose integrity depends on alignment.

activation_trace.role: Alignment on a straight line supplies the ordering principle for distinct participants.
Building by joining parts activates a structural sense around the focus ayah's filial vocabulary.
Tight compaction supplies the load-bearing relation required among the joined links.
Filiation and derived belonging anchor the architecture in son of Mary and sons of Israel.
Successive batches let messenger links occupy separate but coordinated positions in the structure.

structural_cues: 61:4 moves from a straight rank to a joined and compacted building.
61:6 repeats the same root in two different affiliations before repeating messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aligned ranks, joined construction, compaction, filiation, and messenger succession; I infer that the focus affiliations place people as supports in a transmission structure. The alternative is to keep the building strictly as a battle-line simile unrelated to kin terms.

changed_reading.before: The filial titles identify speaker and audience, while the messenger prediction is a separate proposition.
changed_reading.after: The filial titles position speaker and audience inside a built lineage of transmission, with messengers as aligned supports whose relation must be maintained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Moses episode supplies a recursive model of rejection: acknowledged messengerhood meets harm, an initial deviation is followed by further turning, and guidance is lost. That sequence makes the magic label in 61:6 an operation that turns disclosed signs away from their face, not evidence that the signs lacked clarity.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message establish the direct parallel to the focus speaker's claim.
Departure from straightness supplies both the initiating and intensified movement of refusal.
Turning a thing away from its face gives the deviation a perceptual mechanism.
Gentle indication toward a path names the orientation that recursive deviation blocks.
Appearance and clarity keep the evidence positive before the audience redirects it.
Diversion and deception makes magic the audience's instrument for bending the signs' orientation.

structural_cues: 61:5 and 61:6 each begin with a remembered messenger addressing the children or people of Israel.
The earlier scene explicitly places prior knowledge before deviation; the focus places clear signs before the magic label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a parallel messenger scene, prior knowledge, repeated deviation, turned hearts, and blocked guidance; I infer a feedback loop in which refusal reshapes perception. The alternative is that 61:5 and 61:6 merely list separate historical rejections without a shared cognitive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Calling the signs magic is a mistaken assessment of ambiguous evidence.
changed_reading.after: Calling clear signs magic is an active deflection that can reinforce the very curvature from which it arose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fabrication-and-call context sharpens the naming contest. The announced name offers a mark by which arrival can be known, while the magic label cuts the presented signs out of that relation and stitches them into a fabricated category even as the hearers are being called elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Cutting for repair or stitching supplies the exploratory mechanics of removing and recategorizing evidence.
Fabricated falsehood fixes the moral direction of that cutting operation.
The contrary of truth marks the resulting category as an inversion rather than a neutral alternative.
A verbal call that inclines its hearer keeps a competing orientation active during the false naming.
A visible identifying mark anchors the true recognition category in the announced name.
False attribution anchors the recategorizing act in the respondents' own speech.

structural_cues: 61:7 follows immediately after the focus and juxtaposes fabrication against a present call.
61:6 places an announced designation before the audience's deictic counterlabel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fabrication, literal cutting and stitching, falsehood, a verbal call, and two rival labels; I infer categorization as the arrow joining them. The alternative is to treat cutting and stitching as a remote material image and retain only the ordinary falsehood sense.

changed_reading.before: The audience simply supplies the wrong description of the signs.
changed_reading.after: The audience performs a counterclassification, cutting the signs away from their announced identifying relation and attaching them to a fabricated one.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mouth-and-light scene recasts the final saying in 61:6 as attempted oral occlusion. A mouth opens in speech to cool a flame, but the disclosed sign reaches completion. The accusation can redirect reception, yet it cannot make the underlying disclosure cease.

activation_trace.role: A flame becoming still and embers cooling supplies the intended effect of the opponents' act.
Illumination supplies the visible disclosure that the mouth tries to suppress.
Opening the mouth in speech identifies verbal output as the attempted means of occlusion.
Reaching completion supplies the counterforce that outlasts attempted extinguishing.
The tongue as instrument of speech anchors the contextual mouth mechanism in the final accusation.
Meaning disclosed through sign is the focus-ayah material that speech attempts to occlude.

structural_cues: 61:6 ends with a spoken label immediately before 61:8 describes mouths attempting extinguishment.
The focus repeats the disclosure root in the signs and in the accusation itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an accusation, mouths opened in speech, attempted extinguishing, light, and completion; I infer that the accusation is one local instance of oral occlusion. The alternative is that 61:8 concerns a broader campaign with no specific backward link to 61:6.

changed_reading.before: The magic accusation successfully closes the encounter for its speakers.
changed_reading.after: The accusation is a mouth-level attempt to cool disclosure; it may divert hearers, but it cannot terminate the sign's movement toward completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sending, guidance, truth, and manifestation make the focus ayah's backward confirmation and forward announcement a historical disclosure apparatus. Truth is not only a proposition matched to reality; it becomes outwardly legible through successive dispatch, guidance, fulfillment, and appearance.

activation_trace.role: Being sent forth supplies the contextual propulsion of the messenger and message.
Gentle indication toward path and truth gives dispatch an orienting function.
Establishing and manifesting truth supplies the transition from validity to public realization.
Emergence into view gives the relay an outward historical effect.
Confirmation and fulfillment anchors truth's realization in relation to what came before.
Becoming clear anchors public manifestation in the arriving signs.

structural_cues: 61:9 repeats sending and messenger while adding guidance, truth, and a purpose clause of manifestation.
61:6 itself looks backward by confirmation and forward by announcement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, orientation, reality-establishing truth, outward emergence, and focus fulfillment; I infer that succession is the temporal means by which truth becomes manifest. The alternative is that 61:9 describes only the final messenger's victory and does not generalize the focus relay.

changed_reading.before: Confirmation and prediction authenticate one speaker at one moment.
changed_reading.after: Confirmation and prediction are stages in truth becoming historically manifest through successive, orienting dispatches.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later promise of another beloved thing, a near opening, and renewed good tidings activates announcement as temporal folding. Tidings are the first visible edge of a later event: they do not erase after, but let distance begin to open within the hearer's present.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies a second explicit futurity around the focus promise.
A beginning that opens what follows makes the promised event an aperture into its own sequel.
Temporal nearness counters distance without cancelling chronological sequence.
First visible signs make the command to announce an anticipatory appearance.
Afterness preserves the real temporal distance traversed by the focus announcement.
The focus announcement functions as the first visible edge of the messenger who comes later.

structural_cues: 61:13 binds another, near opening, and an imperative of good tidings in one short sequence.
61:6 binds good tidings directly to a messenger coming after the speaker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies laterness, nearness, an opening that begins what follows, and repeated tidings; I infer that announcement folds a future edge into present perception. The alternative is that the two announcements share rhetoric but not a temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The later messenger remains wholly absent until chronological arrival.
changed_reading.after: The messenger remains later, yet the tidings make his arrival's first visible edge near and operative in the present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing appeal for supporters turns the focus relay from information into embodied carriage. The hand before which earlier disclosure stands becomes both transfer and, through the packet's split mapping, reinforcing strength; the announced succession requires communities that answer, support, and carry it onward.

activation_trace.role: Aid that also makes something manifest gives support both carrying and disclosure functions.
The disciple as supporter supplies a human bearer who answers the messenger's appeal.
Reinforcing strength supplies the culminating action that sustains the believing group.
Hand-to-hand transfer anchors support in the focus image of entrusted passage.
The non-dominant reinforcing-strength mapping makes the hand potentially supportive as well as anterior.
Succession in batches gives embodied supporters something to carry across stages.

structural_cues: 61:14 repeats Jesus son of Mary, changes address to who are my supporters toward God, and records an answering we.
The ayah ends with believers being strengthened and becoming manifest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supporters, an answered appeal, reinforcement, a hand-transfer image, and a shared non-dominant mapped root; I infer that transmission requires embodied carriers. The alternative is to keep between my hands purely idiomatic and treat reinforcement as unrelated later vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: The focus handoff occurs automatically between named messengers and texts.
changed_reading.after: The handoff calls for answering bodies: supporters receive, reinforce, and make manifest what the messenger relation carries.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final split into two wrapped groups and the believers' emergence make the focus root's clarity-separation polarity social. The signs do not mechanically produce consensus; disclosure gathers opposed formations around itself, after which one formation becomes outwardly manifest.

activation_trace.role: A group wrapped together supplies the social form taken by each side of the response.
Emergence and exposure make one group's outcome publicly visible.
Elevation and prevailing add a competitive consequence to becoming visible.
Clarity anchors faction formation in an actual disclosure rather than prior tribal difference alone.
Separation supplies the divergent social effect latent within the same repeated root.
A visible outer surface connects announcement and proof to what eventually appears socially.

structural_cues: 61:14 explicitly records one faction believing and another disbelieving after Jesus' appeal.
The closing state is visible predominance, not retroactive unanimity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two cohesive factions, disclosure, separation, and eventual visible predominance; I infer that clarity catalyzes social differentiation rather than guaranteeing consensus. The alternative is that factional history is an outcome with no semantic relation to the focus root's polarity.

changed_reading.before: Clear signs should end disagreement, so rejection is an anomalous failure of clarity.
changed_reading.after: Clear signs can expose and organize disagreement: the same disclosure around which one group gathers also sharpens another group's separation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses messenger, filiation, skin, and magic into a material nourishment analogy. It remains anchored in four focus-root branches that coherently move from flowing yield to built flesh to visible surface and diverted feeding. Render it only as an exploratory material model, never as the lexical meaning of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Messenger, filial terms, good tidings, and magic all occur within 61:6 and each has a packet branch participating in a body-and-nourishment sequence.

activation_trace.role: Flowing milk or yield supplies transmissible nourishment as the messenger material analogy.
Food building flesh turns filial and communal belonging into a body formed by what it receives.
Visible skin or surface supplies the outward trace of inward formation.
Sustaining or diverting with food supplies the rejecting reinterpretation of the offered nourishment.

changed_reading.before: The messenger transmits information to a genealogically named audience.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, messenger transmission behaves like nourishment that builds a communal body and surfaces visibly, while rejection recodes that feeding as diversion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the specialized color-changing-toy branch of magic. It remains anchored in the focus contrast between an announced identifying mark, arriving clear signs, and the magic label. Downstream prose should present it as a phenomenology of unstable appearance, not as a claim that the word magic denotes a toy here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The announced name, the clear signs, and the audience's magic label create a direct contest over stable and unstable visible identification.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies the stable recognition pole.
Appearance and clarity make visibility itself the contested field.
A color-changing plaything supplies unstable surface appearance as the counter-pole.

changed_reading.before: The audience calls the signs deceptive magic in a generic sense.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the audience experiences a stable announced mark and clear signs as an unstable surface display whose changing appearance defeats recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the most form-distant split mapping of the name root. It remains packet-authorized and anchored to the named messenger plus the focus root's separation-and-connection polarity. Render it only as a lexical provocation: the name may figure a mediating insertion, not literally mean reconciliation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: His name occurs between a later messenger and the arrival scene, while the repeated between-clear root carries both separation and connection.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of reconciliation entering between unlike parties activates the name as a mediating insertion.
Separation supplies the distance between prior, present, and later communities that mediation would address.
A tie connecting parties supplies the relational result tentatively assigned to the named insertion.

changed_reading.before: The name only identifies the later messenger.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the announced name also occupies the interval as a proposed mediating mark between separated stages and parties.

strongest_changes: Confirmation and announcement became two temporal directions of one messenger relay rather than independent credentials.
The magic label became an active counterclassification and recursive deflection of already clear signs, not a response to weak evidence.
Good tidings made a genuinely later arrival begin to appear in the present, while the closing supporters made transmission embodied rather than automatic.
The repeated between-clear root allowed connection, disclosure, and social separation to remain simultaneously live.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah concentrates paired speech, paired messengers, backward confirmation, forward announcement, a raised identifying name, arrival, repeated disclosure language, and counter-speech. Context activates these not as one settled interpretation but as temporal relay, recognition contest, perceptual feedback, material flow, built community, and visible faction formation.
remaining_uncertainties: The swimming-and-watercourse model may be a productive material analogy or may depend too heavily on distant branch resonance.
The reinforcing-hand reading is enabled by an explicit split mapping, but its form distance should remain visible in prose.
The social separation model may reflect deliberate activation of the repeated disclosure root or only contextual recurrence.
The nutritive, color-change, and reconciling-name outliers are coherent enough to retain but too branch-specific to state without containment.
